title: About CoinPattern.app
author: Realistic-Falcon4998
selftext:
I'm sharing trades closed today 3 wins, 4 losses. 1% risk for 2% profit.

If you're still interested in testing my SAAS for 2 weeks, HMU. I can provide a test login account or you can create one.

We have 4 apps: (Crypto Pattern Detector - runs on Binance, Crypto Pattern Executor - connected to Binance for trade automation, Mobile app (Not in Playstore or Appstore yet), Crypto Pattern marketer - Connected to Instagram, Facebook, Reddit and Telegram). 

Both work as expected.

The app is at 17.80% now running from 17th June. However, the app is over 3 years old. I have spent most of the time on iterations.

As a matter of fact, signals are free for now. 

You can actually create a strategy, backtest and mark it live.

The more the strategies, the more the RAM/Computing power you need. We're running on Google Cloud 8GB RAM.

Let me know your opinions!
